integrity: All asymptotic statements are proved analytically; finite numerical checks corroborate the exact channel identity and moments, not mathematical priority or infinite limits. No claim of external or independent certification.
limitations: Infinite homogeneous line, symmetric coin-independent shifts, specified localized coin state, no intermediate position measurement; weak rather than uniform local convergence. Fixed-parameter ballistic limits are covered by established group-velocity theory. Independent priority review is outstanding.
title: Gaussian–Konno critical window in a translation-noise quantum walk
